design_intent: Represent the material/event history needed by the hidden questions while retaining provenance and epistemic status.

concepts.notes: A physically tracked portion of grain; may bear a load or shipment role.
A portion moved or transported together.
An outbound load with a dispatch and carrier context.
A recorded receiving, movement, loadout, transport, receipt, sampling, inspection, title, custody, or processing occurrence.
Facility, bin, loading point, dock, silo, or route endpoint.
A bin, load pit, truck, or silo in which the material is recorded.
Farm, elevator, carrier, broker, or processor.
A separated or designated portion used for analysis.
A recorded test or inspection result about material or sample.
A material output of a processor run.
A possible but not committed cross-source identity mapping.

assertion_policy.positive: assert only consequences supported by at least one source record and a declared reconciliation rule
assertion_policy.candidate: retain plausible alternatives without treating them as co-referential
assertion_policy.negative: assert absence only under a scoped completeness claim
assertion_policy.unknown: use not_established for missing or conflicting links
